description: Office expansions, the same feed as app.fundz.net/office-expansions: new office leases, expansions and relocations that public companies disclosed in SEC 8-K filings (the filer is always the tenant taking space; renewals of existing space are left out unless lease_type asks for them, and factory or warehouse sites unless facility_type asks for them), with address and country, facility type, square footage, exact lease term, annual and total base rent, landlord or sublandlord, start dates and a plain-English summary. A company taking more space is usually about to hire. Filter by state, city, company, lease type, minimum square feet and filing date. Page through every match with page; use since to get only filings on or after a date.

city.description: City of the leased space (partial match), e.g. "Austin"

days.description: Only filings in the last N days (default: all)

facility_type.description: One or more of: office, lab, mixed, manufacturing, warehouse, retail (comma-separated), or all. Default: everything except pure manufacturing and warehouse sites.

lease_type.description: One or more of: new, expansion, relocation, renewal (comma-separated), or all. Default: new, expansion and relocation (renewals excluded).

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). The reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.

since.description: Only filings on or after this ISO date, e.g. "2026-10-01". Overrides days.

state.description: US state 2-letter code(s) of the leased space, comma-separated, e.g. "CA, NY"

name: search_office_expansions
title: Search office expansions
